data.rationale: The proposal gets the right procedure and parameters (IMDb, then Rotten Tomatoes, then an email with the same subject and body templates), but it ends with "Send the draft" when the true workflow says never to send and to click Discard. It also leaves out the Mail tab and the Discard step, treats the recipient as a full email address instead of {friend}@example.com, and adds an unneeded cookie-banner step, so an automation built from it could send a real email.
